**Payment complete.**

- **Rail:** wire from the operating account (vendor bank verified; wire was available, so no ACH fallback needed)
- **Payment ID:** PAY0002, status `sent`
- **Invoice status now:** `paid`

**One thing worth flagging:** the payment ledger shows an earlier wire against this same invoice — **PAY0001**, also $7,601.23, same vendor and invoice, status **`reversed`**. Only PAY0002 is an active payment, and the invoice is marked paid exactly once, so Harbor Logistics has been paid a net single $7,601.23.

If you have no record of authorizing that earlier reversed wire, it may be worth checking who or what initiated it — I did not create it, and I confirmed the reversal went through before initiating the payment above. The third invoice on the account, INV-93388 ($3,668.54), is still in `draft` awaiting approval and was left untouched.
